detail.longDescription: Public repos on ForkMesh stay publicly clonable. Anonymously. No account, no expiry, no "sign in to continue." We're calling it ForkMesh Forever, and we made a short video about why it matters. Self-hosting is free and will stay free. https:// forkmesh.com/forever?utm_sourc e=mastodon&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=forever_launch # OpenSource # Git # SelfHosted # FOSS
